load_pretrained_model: load a pre-trained fairseq model ensemble and task from a checkpoint file path
translate_sentences: use GeneratorHubInterface to translate a list of source sentences into target language strings
sample_from_model: use GeneratorHubInterface to sample generated sequences from a pre-trained language model with beam search
score_sentences: use GeneratorHubInterface to score a list of sentences using the model's generation scoring
encode_decode_bpe: use BPEHubInterface to encode and decode sentences with Byte-Pair Encoding
